title: Topical Agent for Treatment of Red Skin
brief_summary: SR-01 may reduce facial redness. it is a topically applied product. The agent will be applied to local skin areas of subjects with red facial skin to assess affect, and then applied to the whole face to assess efficacy and safety
raw_criteria: Bilaterally symmetric red skin on cheeks Caucasian Age 18-60 years
condition: Bilaterally Symmetric Red Skin on Cheeks
